qualification_policy: Only completed evidence on the exact current source/package/ELF/emulator tuple can qualify a target row. The b542851 four-view guest failed during first-frame execution and contributes no target pass.
notes: Matrix cell render-v4-recompiler-cap48 was replaced by render-v4-recompiler-cap64-lag2: at the current speed the GPU never lags, so in-flight reuse blocking needs an injected 2-kick texture-cache fence lag (HALO_PS2_C3_FENCE_LAG_KICKS, texture cache only; DMA chains and HUD owners keep the real fence).
Closure directories are now keyed by the workload header hash and the fence-lag value; before this a parallel run could link another case's player count.
Held and replacement captures are taken inside live rendering (successor frame 1 / preflight-rejected marker), not at teardown.
Post-swap object pool 2,386,752 B versus the 2,071,936 B budget remains noted; config/memory-budget.json is unchanged.
Effect-kind fx records are still unbound to bitmaps (particles carry their bitmap).

requirements.name: Versioned pointer-free snapshot: four views/cameras/HUD/first-person, shared generation-safe object identity, transforms/palettes, resources, attachments, effects/decals
requirements.evidence: Matrix C3.1 PASS in all 6 render cases (1-4 views, recompiler and interpreter, cap64-lag2): versioned pointer-free snapshot with views, objects, effects.

requirements.name: CE owns simulation, animation, first-person, HUD, and effect decisions; parent consumes immutable data only
requirements.evidence: tests/test_c3_2_parent_boundary.py 15 passed (parent consumers call no CE simulation/animation builders, include no CE game headers, write the snapshot bank only through the allowlisted producers; perf-replay producer is compile-gated off). Guest: every matrix case runs the parent consumer on CE-published snapshots.

requirements.name: Snapshot-bank fit, deduplication, explicit readers, no overwrite/eviction while active; required players/enemies/weapons/vehicles
requirements.evidence: Matrix C3.3 PASS in v2, v3, v4 (recompiler and interpreter) and cap64-lag2: bank fit, readers, unique bipeds/vehicles with controllers equal to the view count.

requirements.name: Fixed renderer owners/chains/workspaces; one begin/end and one age/upload-budget advance per frame across 1–4 views
requirements.evidence: Covered by the C3.9/C3.10 guest checks: one begin/end/budget advance per frame, fixed 1,179,648 B dma_commands owner, emit-failures 0 and owner failures 0 in every render case.

requirements.name: Full-screen/split-screen layouts; each view uses its CE player camera, HUD, and first-person state
requirements.evidence: Matrix C3.5 PASS in all 6 render cases: layouts 1/2/3/4 views, per-view camera, HUD, first-person state, framebuffer captures checked for non-black, non-flat views and no unpainted blocks.

requirements.name: BSP/materials, textures/lightmaps, sky, animated objects/vehicles/weapons/HUD/effects and source parity
requirements.evidence: Matrix C3.6 PASS in all 6 render cases: content/effects path and first-person weapon draws each view.

requirements.name: Texture claims publish after successful queueing; retain source bytes through upload and fence cache reuse against actual chains/GS
requirements.evidence: Matrix C3.7 PASS in all 6 render cases. Pressure case render-v4-recompiler-cap64-lag2 (64-page cap, texture-cache fence lag 2 kicks): evictions under pressure and reuse blocked while in flight, emit-failures 0.

requirements.name: Bounded CE sound-request adapter/recorder/drainer preserving event, owner, position, priority, playback parameters; no SPU2 qualification claim
requirements.evidence: Matrix C3.8 PASS in all 12 cases: bounded sound adapter/recorder/drainer fields, unit-camera listener. SPU2 playback is not qualified here.

requirements.name: Bind native bitmap registration and queue-end to running CE frame
requirements.evidence: Matrix C3.9 PASS in all 6 render cases: native bitmap registration and queue-end bound to the running CE frame, per view, with the HUD reserve (6,400 qw) keeping HUD quads out of capacity refusals.

requirements.name: Combined-renderer proof for fixed four chains, idle-chain geometry, pinned sources through VIF/GS completion, safe reuse/overflow, 1–4 views
requirements.evidence: Matrix C3.10 PASS in all 6 render cases: four-chain in-flight DMA proof, tail and HUD reserves, lease releases observed, emit-failures 0.

requirements.name: Renderer-aware profile replacement with validate-first, drain, old tags live, safe empty-state retry, both emulator modes
requirements.evidence: Matrix C3.11 PASS in all 6 successor cases (none, preflight, load x recompiler, interpreter): renderer-aware drain, previous-map snapshot unpublish, final-release discard of the undrained HUD batch, retry without a second dispose/unload when the failed load already released the map.
